summary: Iteration 108 - JW Process Cost Fixes Testing. Verified 3 user-reported issues: (1) routing-cost endpoint works correctly, (2) item_description field persists, (3) Add Part buttons at top+bottom present. Found 1 BUG: GET /api/job-work/orders list endpoint overwrites per-op charges with combined BOM process_cost for live SCs.

critical.issue: List endpoint overwrites per-op charges with combined BOM fg_process_cost for live (draft/in_progress) SCs. Lines 10414-10415 in server.py: 'if _fg: part["charges"] = _fg' unconditionally overwrites charges, wiping out per-op charges preserved during PUT. This breaks Job Card OS SCs where each line has a SPECIFIC routing's cost.
critical.root_cause: The auto-refresh logic at lines 10402-10420 doesn't check if the part has a process_name (indicating per-op charges). It should skip overwriting charges when process_name is set.
critical.suggested_fix: Add condition: 'if _fg and not part.get("process_name"): part["charges"] = _fg'

action_items: FIX BUG: In GET /api/job-work/orders (server.py ~line 10414), add condition to NOT overwrite charges when part has process_name set. Change 'if _fg: part["charges"] = _fg' to 'if _fg and not part.get("process_name"): part["charges"] = _fg'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 10414-10415: Auto-refresh logic overwrites per-op charges unconditionally. Should preserve charges when process_name is set (Job Card OS).
PUT /api/job-work/orders preservation logic at lines 10538-10588 is correct - it properly matches by (item_id, process_name) and preserves existing charges.
POST /api/job-work/orders at lines 10472-10477 correctly uses find_routing_cost when process_name is provided.
GET /api/bom/routing-cost endpoint at line 1942 is correctly placed BEFORE the /{bom_id} wildcard route.
